title: Fair Market Baseline — Consumer Privacy Policy

fairClauses.title: Advance Notice for Policy Changes
fairClauses.text: Users will receive at least 30 days advance email notice before material updates to the privacy policy take effect.

fairClauses.title: Clear Auto-Renewal & Cancellation
fairClauses.text: Subscriptions auto-renew with explicit prior notice, and users may cancel auto-renewal at any time with one click.
